record.paper_title: Some open problems in computational algebraic geometry
record.original_question: For genus g >= 4, let G be an automorphism group of a genus-g curve and let M_g(G,sigma) be the locus of genus-g curves with automorphism group G and signature sigma. Describe this locus in terms of which theta-nulls vanish.

Problem 19. Let G be an automorphism group of a genus Xg curve and Mg(G, σ) denote the locus of genus g curves with automorphism group G of some signature σ. For g >= 4, describe the locus Mg(G, σ) in terms of the vanishing theta-nulls.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $g\ge 4$ be an integer and let $\mathcal{M}_g$ denote the coarse moduli space of smooth projective curves of genus $g$ over $\mathbb{C}$. For a finite group $G$ and a signature $\sigma=(g_0;m_1,\dots,m_r)$ (where $g_0$ is the genus of the quotient and the $m_i$ are the ramification indices of the cover $X\to X/G$), define
$$\mathcal{M}_g(G,\sigma)=\{[X]\in\mathcal{M}_g : G\hookrightarrow\mathrm{Aut}(X)\text{ with quotient cover of signature }\sigma\}.$$
For a curve $X$ of genus $g$, recall that its period matrix determines theta-characteristics $[\varepsilon]\in(\tfrac12\mathbb{Z}^{2g}/\mathbb{Z}^{2g})$, and the corresponding theta-null is $\theta[\varepsilon](0,\tau)$. A theta-null is said to vanish on $X$ when this value is zero.

Problem: For every $g\ge 4$, every finite group $G$ acting faithfully on a genus-$g$ curve, and every admissible signature $\sigma$, describe the locus $\mathcal{M}_g(G,\sigma)$ explicitly as the subvariety of $\mathcal{M}_g$ cut out by the vanishing of a specified set of theta-nulls (i.e., determine which configurations of vanishing theta-nulls characterize membership in $\mathcal{M}_g(G,\sigma)$).
artifact.category_tag: Theta-nulls and automorphism loci of curves
artifact.status_search_result: The problem of describing automorphism loci $\mathcal{M}_g(G,\sigma)$ in terms of vanishing theta-nulls is known explicitly only in low genus (g=2,3) and for certain cyclic/superelliptic families via Thomae-type formulas. For general $g\ge 4$ and arbitrary $(G,\sigma)$, the characterization remains an active open research direction with no general solution reported.

status_evidence.title: Theta functions and algebraic curves with automorphisms
status_evidence.snippet: Studies thetanulls for cyclic curves of low genus and relates vanishing of thetanulls to automorphism groups, treating g=2,3 explicitly.
status_evidence.claim: Explicit theta-null descriptions of automorphism loci exist for low genus, but the general $g\ge 4$ case is not resolved.

status_evidence.title: On automorphisms of algebraic curves (Contemporary Mathematics)
status_evidence.snippet: Lists open problems including the description of $M_g(G,\sigma)$ in terms of vanishing theta-nulls for $g\ge 4$.
status_evidence.claim: The problem is stated as open.
